balls.text: full on the stump, he gets it away to extra cover, and Punjab will end on 112
good ball, yorker outside off, dug away towards extra cover

ouch, third man has overrun the ball, and that will be fifty for McLaren, it was a full toss and McLaren got an edge down to third man as he had a go at it, but Rahul Sharma overran the ball, stopped, got in a mess, and the ball tricked in to the boundary
low full toss outside off, he fails to get it away, slams it straight to mid off
Parnell continues to bowl it full and in to the batsman, but this time McLaren was ready, smoked it over midwicket, and beat the man in the deep to the boundary, almost carried over the ropes
eep, that is a strange shot from PK, Parnell fired this one in full and on leg stump, he went for a flick on one air, but got a leading edge that looped up safely to Uthappa
now he launches one high over square leg, but there is no one at deep square leg, bounces close to he ropes before it is hauled in, good over for Punjab
shuffles around in the crease, and helps one on leg stump on its way in the air to fine leg, there is a diving stop but the ball trickles in to the boundary
charges in and digs in the bouncer, but it goes way over the batsman's head and is called a wide
McLaren takes off, gets one fuller in his slot on leg stump, and hammers it over deep midwicket, lovely connection that has just disappeared in to the crowd
ooh, what was that, PK went for the pull to a short one that got on to him very fast, but midwicket made no attempt to go for the top edge, jogged towards it, and it fell just in front of him
follows him down the leg side as he backs away, he is cramped and has a weak flail at it, gets beaten
stays in the crease and slams a length ball to deep midwicket
angled in on middle and leg, tucked away to midwicket
backs away, bowler goes full and wide outside off, he reaches out to slap it wide of sweeper cover
gets squared up with one on middle stump, and pushes it away towards extra cover
sprayed wide down the leg side with the angle from over the stumps
gets a thick edge as he looks to slash this one outside off, the ball runs away to third man
goes for the bouncer, PK stands motionless and lets it sail high over him, called a wide
works away a length ball around middle and leg towards midwicket

Uthappa takes a skier, Chawla backed away and tried to flick a fuller ball over square leg, Wagh followed him outside leg stump, and he got it off the edge very high in the air, but Robin judged the catch perfectly
fuller one, hit down the ground to long on for a single
now McLaren looks to pull this one away, and manages to get it behind square
slow short delivery, he waits for it to come, and ungainly gets the pull away in front of square leg
and another one takes off, beating Chawla who makes room and has a go at it
chawla backs away and looks to carve this one over point, gets beaten as it bounces over his blade
makes room outside leg and chops one on middle stump away to third man
ends the over with a tight delivery on the stumps, and that will be the second time-out
skips down the track, but mistimes the lofted inside out shot, and it falls way short of sweeper cover
gets another boundary, short of a length, he just went through with the shot, and got is past the bowler and timed it well enough to beat long on
pushed away to extra cover off the front foot
now he gets a shortish one and pulls through midwicket, there is a man in the deep
comes down the track, and drives, gets it off a thick edge backward of point
gets this one away, it was bowled full and he swung hard at it , and got it straight down the ground, giving long on little chance
this one turns in from middle and he gets in to a tangle, taking it on the body
gets forward and guides this one in front of cover
tossed up full delivery, forced down the ground to long off
goes straight on after pitching around off stump, beats him completely as he stabs from the crease
tossed up wide outside off, but he drives it right back to the bowler
goes for another pull shot, but mistimes the shot straight to the bowler, it was bowled quicker through the air
a touch short, and he rocks back to pull it away wide of long on
pushed away backward of point off the front foot, tight line on off stump
dabbed away late to short third man, they take on the throw, he puts in the dive at the striker's end, and that is what saved him in the end
lures him out, shortens the length and has him poshing feebly, but the ball drops short of cover
pushed firmly with the full face of the bat past a diving Manhas to long off
lovely flight on this one, draws Piyush forward and goes past the attempted drive
fuller on the stump, and he whips it off the front foot past the bowler, but long off cuts off the boundary
almost as an afterthought, Piyush decides to dab a short and wide ball outside off to short third man
whipped away off the back foot, there is no one at midwicket, Rahul goes after the ball, but they have time to take two
pushed away for a single in front of point
almost gets a wicket right away, gets the shortish one to bounce more than the batsman expected, misses the pull, the ball somehow misses the stumps
and again, can;t get the ball past the infield, pushed in front of covers
Yuvraj at mid off with a diving stop, the runs just aren't coming for Punjab
looks to charge out, then decides to stay back and dabs it away, but short third man is there
well forward and smothers the ball with a defensive blade
slapped away wide of extra cover for a single
cut away off the back foot to sweeper cover
too full and on the pads, he capitalises and flicks behind square leg
played out near the wicket off the front foot
slower one, wobbles in the air and ends up on leg stump, he misses out on the flick
hops and gets the steer past a diving man at a gullyish position
pushes forcefully forward and gets the single down to long on
chopped away wide of backward point
jaffa, too good for Piyush, angled in around off and then straightens, leaving him pushing forward helplessly, super over from PArnell, absolutely unlucky not have got a wicket
gets bat to this one finally on middle and tucks it wide of midwicket
looks to launch him with the pull through midwicket, misses out completely as the ball zips past
the full making over being dished out to ryan, now this one jags back in, hits him on the pads as he looks to turn it to midwicket
beats him again, McLaren is all sort of confusion against Parnell, this one goes away outside off stump
ooh, lovely delivery, cuts back in from a length outside off, he drove outside the line, and it sailed just over the stumps, Uthappa thinks there was some edge, but the umpire doesn;t
ends the over with another one on  a length on the stumps, pushed away by Chawla
this one makes him play as it comes in around leg stump, he carefully defends
tries to lure him forward like Nayar, but bowls this one very full and wide, left alone

ho hum, another one falls, floated wide and full outside off stump, Nayar gets forward and has a go at it, but loops it in the air for a dolly to backward point, walks away looking at the toe end of his bat
guides another one wide of point, non-striker wants the run, Nayar gestures furiously with his hand to stop him
gets forward and squeezes out this one to point
dug in short, and it bounces high, outside off stump, and he lets it go
low full toss down the pads, he misses the flick, ball just misses leg stump
third time in succession, this time McLaren bent the knee and decided to go for the forcing cut, but missed again
and again, leaves him groping uncertainly outside off stump as another one takes off
good comeback from Wayne, gets this one to lift and straighten outside off, McLaren comes forward to have a push, and is beaten
lovely flick, gets one fuller on the pads, Parnell has been guilty of that today, and McLaren gets it past the man in the deep, who could have put in the dive but chose not to
now he goes down on a knee, and tries to scoop one from a length outside off, misses and is struck on the pads
almost chopped on to the stumps, goes with an angled bat at this one angled outside off, and gets an inside edge that bounces past the wickets
comes forward and drives this fuller one past a diving short extra cover
outside off stump, guided to third man
gets a single this time to sweeper cover
Ryder loses the radar and sprays this one wide
pushed wide of mid off for a quick single

well, well, if the wickets are not coming, Punjab will gift them away, mindless running, Gautam Gambhir looks like the safest runner compared to this, another pull, this one went to mid on on the bounce, Sunny charged down for the run, despite Nayar putting up a hand to him to stay put, he kept charging and charging even as Nayar had already turned his back to him while always putting up his hand, then Sunny stopped near Nayar to have an argument, the ball meanwhile found its way to the keeper, and Sunny will have to walk back and continue the argument in the dugout
gets this one past mid on, marginally short and he rocked back to pull it past mid on to the boundary
Nayar down the track, and slams this one over mid on who runs back and takes the catch, but Kartik has overstepped, oh well
strays on leg stump, Nayar goes down on one knee and sweeps in the air, but in the gap past short fine leg
tosses this one up a bit, Nayar charges out and Kartik shortens the length a bit, and he has to defend it in the end
starts off on target, flat one on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
stands in the crease, and in the end pushes out this one outside off to point
short of a length this time, he stands tall and tucks it away behind square leg
cannot get this one away, better line and length as well from Parnell
another one on the pads and put away through square leg, there was a man there but it sped away past his dive, and tricked in to the boundary, a flurry of them for Punjab
better line from Parnell, Nayar stands with both feet miles apart in the crease, and leaves it alone outside the off stump
starts off with one on the pads, and he gets a tickle on it that beats the keeper
another tight delivery on a length, defended in to the leg side close to the bowler
gets on top of the bounce on this one, it was short and outside off, he went for the cut, did not time it well and got it in the air, but wide of Ryder at point and it ran away to the boundary
this is what Punjab will need, lots of it, luck, length ball on the stumps, he uncertainly pushes at it from the crease, gets an inside edge that misses the stumps, and flies wide of fine leg

Wagh gets another one, and he is delighted, points a finger to his forehead in wisdom, short and wide outside off stump, the extra bounce consumes another batsman, he slashed at it, and got it to weakly loop in the air, hung around for some time before settling in third man;s hands, could not control the shot in the end
tries to manufacture a pull off one that is not as short, gets it away to mid on in the end
going across the batsman from just short of a length outside off and played out to point, tight stuff from Pune
back of a length, on the stumps, carefully defended, Thomas with this length has given nothing away
shuffles a long way across the stumps, and turns this one backward of square

another one goes, on this wicket this shot is not on, just about short of a length outside off, and he had a go at it from the crease, went in the air for a simple catch to point, the extra bounce did him in
tests out the appreciable bounce in the pitch with the short delivery, and it bounces above the batsman who ducks underneath, Thomas is charged up
he pitches this one up, not full, but outside off stump, and that allowed him to push it in to the gap between extra cover and mid off, races away to the boundary
shuffles and tries to work the angle on this back of a length ball in to the body,  but tucks it to the man at midwicket
another one left alone outside off stump, this one bounces more than the previous one
angled across, on a length, outside off stump, those aren't to be meddled with on a wicket that has some nip and bounce, rightly left alone

back of a length around off stump, he goes on his toes to keep it down in front of point, Murali Kartik runs in from gully and hits the stumps at the  non-striker's end, who had to hurry back as he had backed up a long way in the hope of a run
angled across the right hander from a length, some width and he cuts but right to point on the bounce

flicked right to the man at short fine leg, another full delivery angled in on leg stump, Marsh timed it well, too well, as it carried to short fine leg, who dived forward to take the low catch, Pune have taken out the openers
goes for the yorker, ends up very full outside leg stump, and it is clipped away neatly but straight to square leg
131.8 kph delivery from over the stumps, but sprayed down the leg side with the angle
he is getting good bounce, this one is just short of a length outside off, he was looking to hit it through covers, saw it bounce extra and played it out on the off side
angled in on a length in to the stumps, and it is flicked away to fine leg

Adam Gilchrist walks, he went for the pull to a delivery that bounced a lot around leg stump, good pace from Thomas, and Gilchrist could only get some bat on it through to the keeper who held the snorter, Thomas is delighted
keeping it short of a good length and around off stump, a bit more width this time, Marsh steers it to squarish third man
another short of a length delivery, but this one is a touch straight and allows Gilchrist to pull it away, not with great timing, through square leg
136.3 kph back of a length ball around off, Gilchrist hops and keeps it down as it gets big on him
Yuvraj scythes this one through point, waited on it and put it away, that will be it, Pune begin the IPL on a winning note
sees Yuvraj backing away outside leg and bowls it outside off, but very wide
looks to finish it with another swing on the leg side, but cannot connect this time
Robbie in to the act, that;s what you do for dropping them dollies, you pay dearly, marginally short, and Uthappa swings it with the angle, way over deep midwicket, all timing
now he pinches a single in front of cover
Yuvi, just a tad short, that will do it, stands tall, and lifts it over long on, all the way
Uthappa gets adventurous, waltzes down the track, this one gets big on him, but he manages to pull it to deep midwicket
backs away and slaps a length ball to sweeper cover
trouble for Punjab, Uthappa launches a fuller one over mid on, timing it so well that it carries over the ropes, simple and effective
and Uthappa makes Punjab pay for the drop, lovely straight drive, full face of the bat, and the ball races down the ground
driven with good timing to mid on
dropped atrocious stuff from Punjab, another drop, this time it is dinesh, Yuvraj went for the big drive on the knee, got the outside edge but Karthik put down a simple chance at slip
too full on middle and leg, flicked along the ground in front of square
moves in a tad from middle stump, he gets an inside edge as he pushes half-forward uncertainly, Nayar has bowled well
close to off and back of a length, he stays in the crease and punches it to sweeper cover
punched away in to the off side
another one on the pads, this one is bowled wide of the crease and Yuvraj cannot turn it away with the angle going past him
better line outside off, played away to point off the back foot
on the pads, Yuvraj flicks fine and gets four for the neat effort
driven off the front foot to sweeper cover

dropped boy how did that pop out, Uthappa lofted it over extra cover but there was a man in the deep, he came running in, and had settled under the ball, straight in, and straight out, poor stuff, it was Rimmington
sprayed this one wide outside off
looks to launch this one over midwicket but misses, and takes it on the pad
Uthappa goes weakly at this fuller one which stops a bit on him, almost carries to mid off
on the pads this time, worked away through square leg
similar delivery, this time Yuvraj covers the stumps and lets it go
good delivery from Nayar, in the channel outside off stump, beats Yuvraj who uncertainly has a push at it
full and on the pads, Uthappa flicks airily to deep midwicket
another shortish one, comes back in from outside off, played out to point
swivels and tucks a shortish ball backward of square leg, he is away
Ryder throws it away, backs away and has a heave at a short delivery that bounces high, and takes the edge through to the keeper, needless shot, can Punjab make something out of this?
another one, this time through midwicket, full and on leg stump, Ryder whips it past the man in the circle who chases it all the way to the boundary
Jesse, in the slot for him, full and on the stumps, he lofts it over the bowler's head calmly
moves away after pitching, this time well outside off, Robin uncertainly plays it away to point

lovely delivery and ugly reaction from Nayar, got Manhas to drive at one that was full and angled in, but then moves away to take a faint nick through to the keeper, excellent ball, but then Nayar decides to give Mithun a send off, and lets loose a volley of words
now Nayar gives some width, Manhas goes for it, and gets a thick edge down to third man for four
this one takes off and jags back in sharply, surprises the batsman who fends it away in the end
fuller this time, Jesses drives it in the air to long off
spirits forward and pushes a length ball to deep point
well controlled, it bounced extra, but he pushes it late past point off the back foot
gets too adventurous now, shuffles outside the off stump, looking to put away one through midwicket, misses and takes it on the pads
Mithun this time, stands in the crease, gets a short and wide one, and cuts it high over point, almost carried all the way, too much width
another short ball, this time Jesse stays in the crease and pulls it to deep square leg
creamed, absolutely creamed by Jesse, but finds mid on in the way
Jesse wants to end this quickly, shuffles in the crease, gets a shortish one outside off and carves it high over point
the wrong 'un this time, skids on sharply, keeps low, Manhas in a tangle as he manages to keep it out
lovely delivery, tossed up  for the drive outside off, he goes for it, but it turns a foot past his blade sharply
this one skids straight on around off, he goes back and dabs it late past short third man
tossed up this time, makes no difference, Manhas launches it over extra cover, carries all the way, it was timed so well
short again, this time outside off stump, he cuts hard and it almost carries to cover who dives forward but cannot get to it
starts with a short one that goes straight on, he backs away and pulls behind square, it is chased clumsily by the fielder who puts in the dive, but can't stop it
gets beaten this time, McLaren angled this one across Jesse, who wanted to tee off over extra cover but could not connect
bosh! Ryder hammers this one, just stands in the crease and flays it past mid off who was not far, and had zero chance
cramps him for room with a short of a length ball on middle and leg, played out in front of midwicket
did that one carry? it was steered to gully who dived to his left but could not hold on
throws the bat at this one fuller outside off, and is beaten again
lovely ball, pitches outside off and moves away, luring him in to the drive and beating him
wants to dispatch this one over square leg, Rimmington has been bowling constantly on his pads, he almost swung it to seep square leg, but it fell way short in the end
well played by Manhas, keeps this one down past gully and gets it down to third man
fuller now, but again on the pads, this time Ryder misses out on the flick
poor delivery, short, down the leg side, Ryder happily pulls it to the fine leg boundary on one leg
Jesse gets away with this one, closed the face too early as he looked to turn this one through midwicket, got a steepler of a leading edge that safely went over mid off
casually looks to flick a full ball on the pads away, but gets an edge on to pad
PK off a short run up and bowls a bouncer, Manhas is in some trouble but pulls it in the air, the ball falls short of the man running in from fine leg
this one jags back in from a length and strikes him on the pads, the appeal is turned down, looked to be going down leg, struck him high on the pads too, replays show it would have gone over leg
Mithun dances down the track, and clatters this length ball over covers for a boundary
fuller one on the pads again, but flicked straight to midwicket
straighter on the middle and leg line, he happily tucks it away through square leg
Ryder gets going, carves one that moves away outside off stump wide of a diving point
much fuller on the stumps, he stays in the crease and drives hard to mid off
now he makes contact with a length delivery outside off, but mistimes the drive to mid off
throws his bat at this full and wide one outside off, and misses
better line, around middle and leg, played away in to the leg side
overcooks the angle with this one down the pads, and Manhas picks it away neatly to the fine leg boundary
right on target with a length ball that is angled in, defended on the off side
now this one moves away after coming in with the angle on off, lovely control from PK, he gets a thick edge past slip as he pushes forward
comes back in and it is played out on the leg side
short delivery that bounces high over the batsman, called a wide
swinging in to the batsman around middle and leg, he stays in the crease and gets an inside edge towards square leg
this one comes back in sharply and bounces on Manhas, who does well to keep it down in front of gully
tucked away off the pads in front of square where McLaren goes flying to his right to stop the ball
PK gets a wicket first ball, Smith's horror form with the bat continues, full, wide and there to be put away, but Graeme finds extra cover with a weak drive
